subject: Next steps - deployment decision criteria & sponsor signoffs
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <skapoor@novumai.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps - deployment decision criteria & sponsor signoffs

Hi Samir / Lydia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good alignment across product and ops. Quick recap + proposed commitment checklist so we have a single source of truth. Please confirm owners and any timing constraints.

Key pain we heard
- Latency variability on peak claims validation workflow (95th pct > 1.2s) causing downstream throttling and retries.
- Cost volatility when batch reprocessing spikes overnight — team wants predictable unit economics before committing.

Primary goals
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to < 600ms for single-request paths (pilot scope).
- Demonstrate 40% per-token cost reduction vs current baseline for common claim templates.
- Validate security controls for in-scope PHI flows and retention settings.

Draft Mutual Action Plan (high level) — proposed dates and owners
1) Pilot kickoff & env access — target: 2026-12-06 — Owner: Cardinal ops (Lydia) + Redwood infra (Jonas)
2) Test dataset handoff & workload profile — target: 2026-12-09 — Owner: Cardinal data (Lydia)
3) Canary + performance baseline (7 days) — target: 2026-12-13 to 2026-12-20 — Owner: Redwood eng (Jonas)
4) Security evidence & SOC2 scoping review — target: 2026-12-10 to 2026-12-17 — Owner: Cardinal security (Samir) + Redwood compliance (Monica)
5) Exec signoff / procurement approval — target: 2026-12-22 — Owner: Cardinal procurement (TBD) + Redwood sales (Evelyn)

Open questions / risks
- Who is the formal procurement contact who will process a standard MSA?
- Legal review window — Samir mentioned 2 weeks; please confirm if that is calendar or business days.
- Data retention policy — confirm retention windows for the pilot dataset and whether logs may leave the VPC.

Attachments: I uploaded a draft MPA and a proposed test scope (redwood_mpa-draft-Cardinal.pdf).

Next asks
- Lydia / Samir: confirm procurement & security reviewers by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-25).
- Redwood (Jonas / Monica): prepare a short runbook for the canary test and an infra checklist.
- I'll lock the dates in the shared doc once we confirm owners.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Samir Kapoor <skapoor@novumai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@cardinalhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps - deployment decision criteria & sponsor signoffs

Evelyn — thanks for the concise plan, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement / legal
- Primary procurement contact will be Lydia Chen (copied).
- Legal needs a draft MSA + any data processing addendum. We typically allocate 10 business days for initial review; exceptions possible but need a business justification.

2) Security / SOC2
- Attaching our SOC2 high-level requirements for pilots (Cardinal_SOC2_requirements_v1.pdf). Some items require proof-of-concept evidence (encrypted-at-rest, key lifecycle).

3) Timeline
- The team likes the pilot window but prefers the canary to start 2026-12-14 if possible (end-of-week cutover risk).

4) Success metrics
- Can you add an acceptance criterion for error-rate under synthetic load (target <0.1% for malformed claims)?

I'll loop in our procurement manager if we get to the MSA stage. For now, Lydia will coordinate access and dataset readiness.

—Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Automation & AI Programs | NovaMed (Cardinal pilot sponsor)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <skapoor@novumai.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps - deployment decision criteria & sponsor signoffs

Thanks — quick note from infra/eng perspective after reviewing the draft scope and Cardinal's SOC2 doc.

Adjustments we recommend
- Canary start: 2026-12-14 (aligns with Samir's ask). We'll prep a 72-hour burn-in and then a 7-day observed window.
- Data access: we need a service account + sample dataset (CSV + representative JSON payloads) by 2026-12-09 to validate preprocessing paths.
- KV cache warmup plan: we'll provide a warming tool; expected warmup of 4–6 hours before real traffic.

Risks to communicate to stakeholders
- If legal requires a DPA change, that may push procurement beyond 2026-12-22. Recommend a provisional pilot statement-of-work that does not block experimental runs but still protects PHI.

Action items (Jonas / Monica / Evelyn)
- Jonas: deliver infra runbook + canary checklist by 2026-12-01.
- Monica: compile compliance evidence matrix matching Cardinal_SOC2_requirements_v1.pdf by 2026-12-07.
- Evelyn: confirm procurement lead and handoff timing with Lydia; coordinate MSA draft if procurement confirms.

I'll add these milestones to the shared doc so dates are explicit.

Jonas Weber
VP, Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <skapoor@novumai.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps - deployment decision criteria & sponsor signoffs

Appreciate the quick responses — summarizing final commitments so we can mark owners in HubSpot and lock calendar invites.

Confirmed commitments
- Procurement/proc review owner: Lydia Chen (Cardinal) — procurement timeline: 10 business days for MSA review; tentative exec approval target 2026-12-22.
- Security evidence owner: Cardinal security (Samir) + Redwood compliance (Monica) — deliverables due 2026-12-07.
- Pilot dataset + service account: Cardinal (Lydia) due 2026-12-09.
- Canary window: 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-21 (Jonas to run + monitor).

Outstanding - ask from Cardinal
- Samir: please confirm whether the SOC2 attachment covers encryption key management expectations; Monica will prepare a short evidence packet matching each checklist item.

Next steps for scheduling
- I'll create two calendar events: (1) pilot kickoff 2026-12-06 (30m) and (2) canary daily sync 2026-12-15 (15m recurring through 2026-12-21).
- I'll also pin the MPA draft in the shared Drive link and update owners.

If that all looks right, I'll move the MPA to 'committed' state in HubSpot and share the procurement checklist with Lydia.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_mpa-draft-Cardinal.pdf (link), Cardinal_SOC2_requirements_v1.pdf (received)
